svg.title: Spatial representativeness of a sampling point
svg.desc: Three-panel infographic. 1: the central value C at a sampling point (annual mean, measured or modelled). 2: the tolerance, max(15 % of C; Annex I minimum), with two worked examples for PM10. 3: the representativeness area on a synthetic zone map, refined by excluding cells near a heavily trafficked road and cells with a different source profile.
svg.text: Spatial representativeness of a sampling point
Dir. (EU) 2024/2881 · Impl. Dec. (EU) 2026/1208 · applicable from 30 June 2028

g.text: Spatial representativeness (Dir. Art. 3): the air quality metrics observed at the point are representative of an explicitly
delineated area, within which the metrics do not differ from those at the point by more than a pre-defined tolerance level.
